$comment: Accepted npm advisories: bin/audit.ts fails on any high or critical advisory not listed here, or listed past its reviewBy date.

advisories.reason: Stack-exhaustion DoS on deeply nested glob patterns, reached through stylelint's micromatch. It only expands the globs in our own lint config; no external input reaches it.
max-stale cross-user disclosure in a shared runtime cache, reached through astro. Astro uses it only at build time for remote images; there is no runtime cache and no users.
